gaps.explanation: Re-read pp3-4 and 8-13 (trim has 13 pages). p4 prints four governmental columns (General Fund, Road Funds, COVID American Rescue Plan Fund, Non-major Funds); each has a cash-basis budget schedule in detail (General pp8-9, Road p10, ARPA p11, All Non-Major Special Revenue Funds p12; p13 by-fund receipts 14,676,804 = p12 revenues 10,163,542 + transfers in 4,513,262, not added; nonmajor balance-sheet cash 8,083,477 = p12 ending balance). Nothing counted twice. Per fund, schedule (cash) vs statement p4 (modified accrual): General 92,990,137 vs 97,432,568 (-4,442,431); Road 23,924,852 vs 23,405,298 (+519,554); ARPA p11 prints '-' on every revenue row (cash was received in FY2022) vs p4 Federal 10,317,320 (-10,317,320; GAAP recognizes ARPA revenue as spent, p3 unavailable revenues 11,940,636); Non-major 10,163,542 vs 7,922,506 (+2,241,036). -4,442,431 + 519,554 - 10,317,320 + 2,241,036 = -11,999,161 = gap. The p4 ARPA Federal 10,317,320 is not added: ARPA has its own printed schedule, whose printed revenue is nil; adding the statement cell would mix the two bases for one fund. JSON statement receipts 139,077,692 = p4 Total revenues (correct).

No column or row missing, nothing duplicated. Statement p4 vs schedule per fund: General 99,183,661 vs p9 Total expenditures paid 84,827,551 (-14,356,110; p9 'Reconciliation to balance sheet' prints Disbursements of cash from escrow account for construction (20,337,110) and for interest (1,920), spending outside the cash budget; reconciliation rows, not budget expenditure lines, and not equal to the difference, so not added); Road 52,992,671 vs p10 47,921,924 (-5,070,747); ARPA 10,163,022 vs p11 9,855,042 (-307,980; p3 ARPA accounts payable 323,294); Non-major 13,134,756 vs p12 12,756,171 (-378,585). 14,356,110 + 5,070,747 + 307,980 + 378,585 = 20,113,422 = gap. JSON statement disbursements 175,474,110 = p4 Total expenditures (correct). Lease financing 37,616 and Subscription financing 376,926 (p4 General) are already in detail.

Detail: General 'Operating transfer in' 300,000 (p9), Road 4,000,000 (p10), Non-Major 4,513,262 (p12) = 8,813,262. p4: General 250,000, Road 4,000,000, Non-major 4,513,262 = 8,763,262. The only difference is General 300,000 vs 250,000 (+50,000), printed on the cash schedule; not a duplicate.

Detail: General (8,700,000) (p9), ARPA (154,298) (p11), Non-Major (1,513,262) (p12) = 10,367,560. p4: General (8,700,000), ARPA (154,298), Non-major (1,463,262) = 10,317,560. Only difference: Non-major 1,513,262 vs 1,463,262 (+50,000), the same 50,000 as the General transfer in; the cash schedules show a 50,000 Non-major-to-General transfer that the GAAP statement does not.
